name: How do I choose the right contractor for a walk-in shower installation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a walk-in shower installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, look for licensed and insured professionals with specific experience in walk-in shower installations. Request references and review portfolios of past work. Obtain detailed written bids from multiple contractors to compare costs and scopes of work. Ensure the contractor understands local building codes in areas like San Bruno or South San Francisco. Clear communication, transparency regarding timelines, and a strong track record of quality workmanship are key indicators of a reliable contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with relevant experience, good references, detailed bids, and knowledge of local building codes.
